name: Hellion

bonuses.name: Hit and Run
bonuses.text: The Hellion does not provoke Reflexive Attacks when moving out of Engagement.

bonuses.name: Power From Pain: Flensing Fury
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +1 bonus dice to melee attack Tests until the end of its next Turn.

bonuses.name: Skyboard
bonuses.text: Whilst mounted on a Skyboard the Hellion can Fly at Speed 12 and fire its Splinter Pods as though they were wielding them as a ranged weapon. If the Skyboard is damaged, the Hellion rolls a Complication, or attempts any kind of difficult aerial manoeuvre, he must succeed on a DN 4 Pilot (A) Test or the Skyboard crashes in a random direction according to the Scattering rules. Crashing deals a minimum of d3 Shock and may trigger falling damage.

abilities.name: Helion Assault
abilities.text: Whilst mounted on a Skyboard a Hellion may charge as a Combat Action and Fall Back as a simple Action.

abilities.name: Whips of the Master
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to target an allied creature with the <BEAST> Keyword within 4m. The target suffers 1 Shock damage, but gains +2 bonus dice to all melee attacks and +2 Speed until the end of its next turn.

note: Print: the Hellglaive's ED is printed "+64 ED", stored as printed (likely 6 or 4); "Helion Assault" has one L; its AP prints "– 4".
